items.title: Mortgage Rates Are Now 1% Higher Than They Were a Year Ago
items.author: Colin Robertson
items.content: If you asked someone a year ago where mortgage rates would be today, my guess is they wouldn’t say one full percentage point higher. items.title: No Relief for Mortgage Rates as August Jobs Report Comes in Hot
items.author: Colin Robertson
items.content: Any hope of a trend reversal for mortgage rates seems to be DOA. A cooler-than-expected jobs report this morning could have taken the pressure off. But instead, it came in well above expectations, piling even more pain onto interest rates. It also increased the odds of a September Fed rate hike to over 60%. Perhaps… Read More »

items.title: Mortgage Rates Are at New 2026 Highs, But There’s a But
items.author: Colin Robertson
items.content: You’ve probably heard that mortgage rates hit a new 2026 high. That’s true. The 30-year fixed climbed to 6.89%, per the latest daily rate update from Mortgage News Daily.
